note: platform control groups -- renders fixed navigation and action-button vocabulary
sidebar toolbox -- renders the platform's fixed title and sidebar controls
sidebar section headings -- renders fixed category labels
sidebar item action controls -- renders fixed menu-button actions, not the user-created item names
directory heading -- renders the platform's fixed page title
directory tabs -- renders the fixed tab vocabulary and tab controls
directory table header -- renders fixed column labels and sorting controls
pagination controls -- renders fixed paging actions and the platform's pagination display
